1. (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than 2000 Da and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, __wherein said polyalkylenimine and polyanion are present in a molar ratio such that the polyalkylenimine is in excess of the polyanion__.

2. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker, __wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is present in an amount sufficient to crosslink said polyanion__.

3. (Original) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is polyethylenimine.

4. (Original) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and anionic surfactants.

5. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is a complexed zirconium compound selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, zirconium orthosulfate, zirconium oxychloride, zirconium carbonate, zirconium ammonium carbonate, zirconium acetylacetonate, aluminum chloride, aluminum sulfate, aluminum citrate, tin chloride, tin sulfate, iron chloride, iron nitrate, titanium chloride, and titanium sulfate, __wherein said zirconium compound is present in an amount of at least 0.1 molar equivalents relative to the polyanion__.

6. (Original) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium or calcium ions.

8. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex comprised a nanoparticle with an average particle size of about 100 to 900 nm in diameter, __and wherein said nanoparticle exhibits a zeta potential of less than -20 mV or greater than +20 mV__.

9. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticles are stable in water, field brine and seawater, __and wherein stability is measured as retention of nanoparticle size within 20% over a period of at least 30 days__.

10. (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS), said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, __wherein the polyalkylenimine and PVS are present in a molar ratio such that the PVS is in excess of the polyalkylenimine__.

12. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a multivalent cation, __wherein said multivalent cation is complexed with said PVS__.

13. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe or Al, __wherein said multivalent cation is present in an amount of at least 0.05 molar equivalents relative to the PVS__.

21. (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1, __wherein the polyalkylenimine is in excess of the polyanion__; b) a polymer that can be crosslinked with a); and c) a fluid.

22. (Original) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is an acrylate-based polymer.

23. (Original) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is partially hydrolyzed polyacrylamide.

24. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethylacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acrylamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acrylamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, __and wherein said polymer has a molecular weight of at least 100,000 Da__.

26. (Original) The composition of claim 21, where fluid is brine or seawater.
